text.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ

words.gloss_range: near demonstrative presenting the completed discourse as immediately before the listener
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰذَا}} ({{tr:hādhā}}) opens the final ayah by pointing at the proclamation as present and identifiable. The demonstrative can hold this ayah, the completed surah, and the broader revelation in view, because the predicate can name each as a communiqué. The nominal sentence makes the discourse stand before the listener as a present transmission, while the boundary from 14:51 turns the reckoning scene back into present-world warning.

topics.headline: present deictic declaration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final ayah points to the discourse as a present, identifiable communiqué rather than narrating a new event.
topics.reason: The near demonstrative is the subject of a nominal clause, and the cross-reference evidence lets its referent include the delivered proclamation rather than only the previous sentence.

topics.headline: reckoning-to-proclamation turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene turn from divine reckoning in 14:51 back to present-world warning through the message.
topics.reason: Boundary rows cohere with the opening nominal clause: the prior judgment scene is followed by a self-presentation of the message.

words.gloss_range: indefinite verbal noun naming the discourse as sufficient delivered communication
words.root_gloss_range: reaching, arriving, attaining sufficiency, and conveying; the local maṣdar selects completed communicative arrival
words.prose: {{ar:بَلَٰغٌ}} ({{tr:balāghun}}) is an indefinite maṣdar predicate: this is a delivered communication, not a new command to deliver it. The b-l-gh field lets the word carry arrival and sufficiency, so the message has reached its human addressees and now enables warning, knowledge, and remembrance. Its sparse noun distribution suits a surah-ending summary of messenger-duty, and after 14:51 the prior reckoning pressure becomes the warning content carried by this delivered message.

topics.headline: indefinite maṣdar predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the message is identified as a standing delivered result, not as a fresh command to deliver or a past act of delivery.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as an indefinite nominative verbal noun functioning as the predicate of the nominal sentence.

topics.headline: communication that reaches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the message is not just information; the b-l-gh field presents it as communication that reaches its addressees and suffices for its purpose.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports arrival and sufficiency, and the local maṣdar applies that pressure to communication.

topics.headline: summative closure noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this sparse noun choice suits a surah-ending summary of messenger-duty and sufficient delivery.
topics.reason: Distribution rows make the exact noun a marked closure form within the wider common root.

topics.headline: arrival before warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that delivered communication becomes the medium by which the prior reckoning pressure turns into present warning for people.
topics.reason: Local sequence and boundary rows agree that the proclamation precedes and enables the warning clause.

words.gloss_range: recipient lām marking the message as for humankind before the purpose clauses begin
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li-}}) first marks the proclamation as to, for, and assigned to humankind. Its job differs from the later purposive lāms: here the particle governs the recipient phrase and fuses to the definite collective, establishing the audience before the triple goal sequence begins.

topics.headline: recipient lām before purpose lāms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first lām marks the audience of the proclamation, while later identical-looking lāms govern the goals of that proclamation.
topics.reason: QAC marks word 3 as lām al-jarr governing the genitive human audience, not as a purposive lām governing a verb.

topics.headline: directed human-facing address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the message is directed to, for, and assigned to the human audience before the triple purpose cascade unfolds.
topics.reason: The preposition is fused to the following definite collective noun and locally attaches to the proclamation predicate.

words.gloss_range: definite collective human audience receiving the proclamation before the close narrows to possessors of intellect
words.root_gloss_range: human public, people, sociability, perception, and a debated forgetfulness association; the local noun selects the collective human audience
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) names the definite collective human audience of the proclamation. The word gives the message species-wide reach, while its human-capacity pressure suits an audience that can perceive, forget, be warned, and then be narrowed to those who truly remember.

topics.headline: universal human recipient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proclamation first addresses humankind as a collective recipient before the ayah narrows to the class able to internalize it.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, collective, and genitive under the first lām, making it the audience rather than the subject of the opening clause.

topics.headline: human capacity and forgetfulness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressed humans are not a flat mass: the derivational pressure suits beings who perceive socially and need warning and remembrance.
topics.reason: The local word selects the collective human audience; derivational disputes may color why warning and remembrance fit humans, but they do not replace the local audience sense.

topics.headline: from all people to possessors of intellect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah-wide funnel: all people receive the message, but the final act of remembrance is assigned to possessors of core intellect.
topics.reason: Contextual rows and local syntax both support the shift from the broad recipient phrase to the final specified subject.

words.gloss_range: coordinating wāw that starts the first purpose movement after the audience phrase
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) attaches the first purpose clause to the declaration. The repeated wa-li onset begins here, so warning is heard as the first coordinated outcome rather than a detached sentence.

topics.headline: first coordinated purpose onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that warning is coordinated onto the proclamation as the first movement in a repeated purpose sequence.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the first purpose clause with the opening declaration and forms the first repeated wa-li onset.

words.gloss_range: first purposive lām governing the passive warning verb
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li-}}) makes warning the first telos of the proclamation. The lām governs the following subjunctive passive verb, so the clause describes what the message is for, not merely what happens after it.

topics.headline: warning as first telos
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that warning is framed as an intended function of the message, not merely as something reported after it.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark this lām as purposive and governing the subjunctive passive warning verb.

words.gloss_range: passive Form IV warning verb under purposive lām, with people as recipients of advance alert
words.root_gloss_range: warning, advance notice, and a distinct vow or dedication branch; the local Form IV passive selects being warned
words.prose: {{ar:يُنذَرُوا}} ({{tr:yundharū}}) makes people recipients of warning under the first purposive lām. Its Form IV passive foregrounds received advance danger-notice and leaves the warner unexpressed, while the vow or dedication branch stays as summons-like background pressure rather than the selected sense. Active-warner and dedication variants sharpen that the canonical sequence begins with reception before active knowledge and reflexive remembrance.

topics.headline: passive received warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that people first appear as recipients of warning, with the warner left unexpressed and the purpose frame foregrounded.
topics.reason: The local form is Form IV passive, subjunctive under purposive lām, so the human group receives the warning rather than acting as warners.

topics.headline: advance alert with dedication pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is advance danger-notice with a summons-like seriousness, while the local Form IV passive does not activate the Form I vow sense as the selected meaning.
topics.reason: The n-dh-r evidence supports both warning and vow branches; local morphology selects passive warning and keeps dedication as background pressure only.

topics.headline: variant agency contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how variant agency possibilities sharpen the canonical reading: here the people are first warned before later becoming active knowers.
topics.reason: Accepted variant evidence can illuminate contrast, but the local canonical surface remains passive Form IV.

topics.headline: passive-to-active-to-reflexive arc begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first verb begins a graded cognitive arc: being warned, then knowing, then self-directed remembrance.
topics.reason: The three purpose verbs are coordinated in parallel frames, and this first one is the passive starting point of the sequence.

words.gloss_range: instrumental bāʾ with a 3ms suffix tying the warning back to the message
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) ties the warning back to the proclamation through a compact preposition-plus-pronoun. The suffix can gather the immediate message and broader delivered discourse, while the bāʾ makes that message the instrument and cause by which the prior reckoning content warns.

topics.headline: anaphoric bridge to the message
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning clause is not free-floating; the pronoun routes it back to the present proclamation and broader delivered discourse.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the suffix as a pronoun complement whose antecedent is strongly tied to the preceding proclamation.

topics.headline: message as warning instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the message is both the means and cause by which the prior reckoning content becomes warning.
topics.reason: The bāʾ phrase attaches to the passive warning verb and carries the 3ms pronoun back to the message.

words.gloss_range: coordinating wāw that gives knowledge its own second purpose slot
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) opens a second coordinated purpose. It prevents knowledge from being swallowed into warning and preserves the measured triad of warning, knowing, and remembrance.

topics.headline: knowledge receives its own slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge is coordinated as a second purpose, not collapsed into warning as a restatement.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the second wa-li purpose onset and coordinates it with the first purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: second purposive lām governing the active knowledge verb
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li-}}) places knowing divine unity inside the same purposive scaffold as warning. Because it governs an active knowledge verb, the ayah shifts from being alerted to the epistemic target that the message aims to produce.

topics.headline: knowledge as epistemic telos
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowing divine unity is an intended target of the proclamation and is placed in the same purpose frame as warning.
topics.reason: QAC marks this lām as purposive before a subjunctive active knowledge verb, parallel to the warning frame.

words.gloss_range: active plural knowing verb with the unity proposition as its content
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, certain recognition, and sign or landmark pressure; the local verb selects active knowledge of the stated proposition
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُوا}} ({{tr:yaʿlamū}}) is the middle verb of the purpose chain: the broad human audience now actively knows a full proposition. The root pressure is certain recognition of a marked truth, not supposition or secondhand informing, and the verb becomes the hinge between passive warning and self-directed remembrance.

topics.headline: active knowing with explicit content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agency shift: the same broad audience that receives warning must actively know a full proposition.
topics.reason: The verb is active plural and takes the annamā unity clause as its clausal complement.

topics.headline: certain marked knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the target is firm recognition of a marked truth, not vague awareness or secondhand information.
topics.reason: The root evidence supports certain knowledge, while the Form I surface centers the people as knowers rather than a causative teaching act.

topics.headline: hinge between warning and remembrance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge stands between alert and internalized remembrance, focused specifically on divinity and oneness.
topics.reason: The local sequence and co-occurrence evidence both support knowledge as the middle cognitive function of the message.

words.gloss_range: restrictive compound particle focusing the content of knowledge on the unity clause
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّمَا}} ({{tr:annamā}}) focuses what is to be known. Its restrictive force and kāffa-makfūfa syntax make the following unity statement a full, bounded proposition: rival deity-candidates are excluded as the clause defines the content of knowledge.

topics.headline: particle reparse and clause syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle shape controls how the unity clause is parsed, freeing the following pronoun as the subject of a full proposition.
topics.reason: QAC treats the form as a compound restrictive particle; alternate segmentation is useful as reparse pressure but does not override the local kāffa-makfūfa parse.

topics.headline: restricted knowledge content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of knowledge is sharply bounded: rival deity-candidates are excluded by the restriction before the unity predicate is stated.
topics.reason: The particle governs the content of what is to be known and marks restrictive scope over the embedded unity proposition.

words.gloss_range: independent pronoun anchoring the subject of the embedded unity proposition
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) anchors the embedded unity clause before the deity predicate appears. It points back to the divine referent from 14:51 without repeating the proper name, shifting the discourse from divine action to divine identity.

topics.headline: anchored subject of unity clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unity claim has a stabilized subject; the predicate does not float as an unanchored title phrase.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun stands as the subject of the embedded nominal clause before the deity predicate.

topics.headline: identity by pronoun rather than name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shift from the named divine actor in 14:51 to a pronoun that points to the same referent while the predicate defines identity.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence licenses the pronoun as resuming the divine referent, and the local clause moves from reference to predicate definition.

words.gloss_range: indefinite deity noun used as a category predicate inside the knowledge clause
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, refuge, awe, and disputed love-bewilderment pressure; the local common noun names the category to be restricted as one
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَٰهٌ}} ({{tr:ilāhun}}) names deity as an indefinite category predicate, then lets the following unity adjective qualify that category. The lexical field of worship, refuge, awe, and ultimate orientation survives, while the local grammar makes the known proposition a recurring monotheistic formula. Across the boundary, divine recompensing in 14:51 becomes divine identity as knowable oneness in 14:52, within a close that mirrors 14:1's purpose-plus-people frame.

topics.headline: deity as restricted category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause asserts oneness over the category deity, not merely by repeating a proper name.
topics.reason: The local word is an indefinite nominative common noun predicate of the pronoun, qualified by the following unity adjective.

topics.headline: worship and ultimate orientation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that deity names the sole object of worship, refuge, awe, and ultimate orientation; derivational disputes enrich that force without replacing the local noun sense.
topics.reason: The lexical field supports worship and awe pressure, while local syntax keeps the word as a common category predicate.

topics.headline: known unity formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase belongs to a recurring monotheistic formula and is placed here as the content the message makes known.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and formula rows align with the local sequence: knowing is directed to the deity-plus-oneness proposition.

topics.headline: from divine action to identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary shift from divine recompensing in 14:51 to divine identity as knowable oneness in 14:52.
topics.reason: Boundary rows are coherent when limited to the transition from prior divine action to the local identity-category predicate.

words.gloss_range: nominative indefinite unity adjective qualifying the deity noun
words.root_gloss_range: oneness, singleness, solitude, and non-rivalrous uniqueness; the local adjective qualifies the deity category
words.prose: {{ar:وَٰحِدٌ}} ({{tr:wāḥidun}}) agrees with the deity noun and locks oneness to it. Its singularity excludes rivals while remaining the describable unity adjective rather than the absolute one formula of 112:1, and the same unity attribute moves from judgment dominance in 14:48 into proclamation as doctrine. Its cadence completes the nominal thread that links the opening communication noun, the deity noun, and this unity adjective.

topics.headline: oneness locked to deity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that oneness grammatically qualifies the deity noun and closes the knowledge proposition rather than standing as an independent slogan.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a nominative indefinite adjective agreeing with the deity noun.

topics.headline: one without rival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local word carries both countable oneness and qualitative non-rivalry, while the choice is wāḥid rather than the absolute aḥad formula of 112:1.
topics.reason: The w-ḥ-d field supports singularity and solitude; comparison with aḥad is useful but does not change the local adjective.

topics.headline: proclamation-form unity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unity attribute moves from the judgment scene in 14:48 into a proclamation clause as doctrinal knowledge.
topics.reason: The same-surah and co-occurrence rows support the adjective as part of a local and Quran-wide unity formula.

topics.headline: final -un cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shared -un sound binding message, deity, and oneness across the ayah nominal backbone.
topics.reason: The nominative indefinite ending is visible on the predicate noun and its adjective and matches the opening predicate cadence.

words.gloss_range: coordinating wāw that reopens the purpose chain after the unity proposition
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) reopens the purpose chain after the unity proposition. The ayah does not stop at knowing oneness; it adds one final coordinated outcome.

topics.headline: third purpose reopened
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at knowing unity; the conjunction reopens the sequence for a final act of remembrance.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the final purpose clause with the previous purpose clauses and repeats the wa-li onset pattern.

words.gloss_range: third purposive lām governing the final remembrance verb
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li-}}) makes the following remembrance verb the final telos of the message. The third purposive lām completes the scaffold and continues the purpose logic that answered the recompense frame of 14:51.

topics.headline: remembrance as final telos
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remembrance is framed as the final purpose of the message, not as a decorative afterthought to knowledge.
topics.reason: The third purposive lām governs the Form V remembrance verb and completes the repeated purpose scaffold.

topics.headline: judgment purpose becomes message purpose
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices continuity between the purpose of recompense in 14:51 and the multiplied purpose logic of proclamation in 14:52.
topics.reason: Boundary rows are supported as structural continuity across adjacent purpose expressions, without making 14:51 govern the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: Form V singular remembrance verb making the final purpose self-directed taking heed
words.root_gloss_range: mention, remembrance, reminder, distinction, and taking heed; the local Form V selects internalized reflection
words.prose: {{ar:يَذَّكَّرَ}} ({{tr:yadhdhakkara}}) crowns the triad as Form V self-directed remembrance. Its singular shape individualizes the act within the qualified group, and the sense is reflective taking heed rather than bare mention or an unrelated gendered branch. The doubled sound gives the verb weight, while the same-surah dhikr thread moves from the command to remember grace (14:6) and the broader hope of taking heed (14:25) into final remembrance by those with core intellect.

topics.headline: individualized self-remembrance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final act is self-directed and individualized, even though the subject phrase names a qualified group.
topics.reason: The verb is Form V, singular, active, and governed by purposive lām; it takes the explicit ulū phrase as subject.

topics.headline: taking heed over bare mention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that remembrance here means reflective taking heed and self-admonition, while unrelated gendered branches of the root remain outside the local sense.
topics.reason: The dh-k-r field is broad, but Form V with possessors of core intellect selects internalized reflection rather than mere verbal mention or nonlocal branches.

topics.headline: passive-active-reflexive climax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agency climb: warning is received, knowledge is acquired, and remembrance is internalized as the highest cognitive outcome.
topics.reason: The coordinated purpose verbs support a progression from passive to active to reflexive agency.

topics.headline: dhikr joins knowledge and intellect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah’s remembrance thread is gathered into the final purpose and narrowed to the intellect-bearing class, with contrasts to 14:6 and 14:25.
topics.reason: Same-surah and co-occurrence evidence supports remembrance as the completion of the local knowledge and intellect chain.

topics.headline: heavy doubled remembrance sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the doubled, assimilated sound makes the final cognitive act feel weightier than the earlier purpose verbs.
topics.reason: The Form V tadhakkara pattern is compressed into the doubled surface, matching the reflexive meaning with audible weight.

words.gloss_range: construct plural possessors naming the qualified subject of final remembrance
words.root_gloss_range: priority, firstness, return, and possession; the local construct form selects possessors of the named faculty
words.prose: {{ar:أُو۟لُوا}} ({{tr:ulū}}) supplies the explicit subject of the final remembrance verb. As a defective construct plural with no ordinary singular counterpart here, it selects possessors of the named faculty rather than a simple demographic group, narrowing the audience from all people to the recognized class capable of extracting the message's meaning.

topics.headline: possessors as final subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final remembering subject is explicitly named by possession of a faculty, not left as the earlier broad human plural.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify ulū as the nominative construct head and subject of the remembrance verb.

topics.headline: defective construct plural selector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form functions as a selector of possessors rather than a normal plural label for people.
topics.reason: The ʾ-w-l priority field is background; the following genitive complement selects the possession construction locally.

topics.headline: from people to possessors of intellect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final narrowing from all people as recipients to the recognized Quranic class capable of extracting meaning.
topics.reason: The local phrase and contextual formula evidence support a shift from universal reception to qualified reflection.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive broken plural naming the possessed core intellect
words.root_gloss_range: kernel, pith, pure inner core, stable remaining, and intellect; the local plural names distributed inner understanding
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ}} ({{tr:al-albābi}}) is the definite genitive faculty possessed by that final subject. The l-b-b kernel metaphor makes intellect the inner, stable core of comprehension, the plural distributes that core across its possessors, and the recurring intellect-address formula makes the final audience recognizable. After the repeated purpose verbs, the long final nominal cadence lands the surah on the capacity able to internalize warning and unity.

topics.headline: definite possessed intellect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that intellect is the possessed quality defining the final subject, and it is definite rather than an indefinite trait.
topics.reason: The word is definite genitive under the construct head ulū, making it the possessed faculty in the subject phrase.

topics.headline: kernel as inner understanding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the physical kernel-to-intellect metaphor: the final demand lands on an inner, stable core of comprehension, not surface cleverness.
topics.reason: The l-b-b field supports core and pith imagery; the local abstract plural selects intellect as inner comprehension.

topics.headline: plural Quranic intellect formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the broken plural distributes the inner-core faculty across the possessors and belongs to a recurring intellect-address formula.
topics.reason: Form and distribution rows support the plural abstract noun as a formulaic marker of deep-understanding audience.

topics.headline: surah closes on core intellect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah closes not on warning alone or on abstract doctrine alone, but on the faculty capable of internalizing both.
topics.reason: Final-position, co-occurrence, and convergence rows all support the word as the cognitive landing of the ayah and surah.

topics.headline: final nominal cadence landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the marked final landing: a relatively rare intellect formula ends the sequence after repeated purpose verbs.
topics.reason: The cadence and rarity rows add a valid final-position payoff without changing the lexical sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: balagh at word 2 and the three coordinated purpose clauses at words 4-13
baseline_models.mechanism: Message-delivery makes the demonstrative's content a public transmission whose intended effects are staged as warning, knowledge of the one deity, and recovered recollection.

activation_trace.role: Literal delivery of a message makes the demonstrative's content the carrier of the purpose chain.
The visibly human collective supplies a public audience rather than an esoteric circle.
Danger-reporting that wakes caution supplies the first intended effect.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the cognitive transition after alarm.
Divine oneness without partner specifies what is to become known.
Recovery after forgetting supplies the final inward reactivation.

changed_reading.after: A public transmission designed to move hearers through alarm, recognition of divine unity, and durable recollection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: balagh at word 2, knowing at word 6, recollection at word 11, and the packet's mapped root for ulu at word 12
baseline_models.mechanism: Reaching an endpoint combines with a guiding mark, renewed presence, and a return-to-outcome image, making the verse an arrival point from which qualified readers face the matter's eventual issue.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at a limit makes this verse a terminal point rather than only a dispatch.
A distinguishing mark turns knowledge into orientation at that endpoint.
A reminder restores the reached matter to active presence.
The mapped return-to-outcome image turns the final possessive construction toward ma'al, with form-distance kept explicit.

changed_reading.before: The verse only reports information at the end.
changed_reading.after: The verse is an arrival point that marks the outcome and turns reflective readers back toward it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: balagh at word 2 governing warning, knowing, and remembering
baseline_models.mechanism: Balagh as sufficient provision makes the content usable equipment: caution wakes the user, a mark gives direction, and reminder keeps the provision available.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency and subsistence make the content equipment with which people can proceed.
Awakened caution activates the provision under danger.
A distinguishing sign gives the provision cognitive direction.
A reminder makes that equipment recoverable for repeated use.

changed_reading.before: A notice that has merely been delivered.
changed_reading.after: A sufficient cognitive provision that equips caution, orientation, and repeated recall.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening book descends to move people outward from darkness into light, while messenger-language exposes meaning; balagh therefore operates as an intelligible extraction medium, not inert information.

activation_trace.role: Message-delivery anchors the changed model in balagh.
Ordered writing supplies the delivery's textual carrier.
Caused descent and conveyance put that carrier into its receiving field.
Passage to the outside gives delivery a transformational direction.
Illumination names the disclosed destination of that passage.
Language and speech make delivery locally receivable.
Verbal disclosure of meaning makes intelligibility the operative link.

structural_cues: 14:1 assigns the book the purpose of bringing people from darkness to light.
14:4 ties sending to the language of the messenger's people and to clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, outward passage, light, language, and clarification; I infer that delivery transforms by becoming locally intelligible. A live alternative is that these remain coordinated functions rather than one causal mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Balagh is the intelligible carrier by which an audience can be moved from concealment into disclosed orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Signs, charged historical days, transmitted news, examples, and inhabited remains make recollection reconstructive: the reader reassembles a recurring pattern from traces rather than retrieving an isolated proposition.

activation_trace.role: Recovery after forgetting anchors the model in the focus act of recollection.
Visible signs supply recoverable historical traces.
An explicit reminder makes those traces present again.
A charged day's event gives remembrance a historically bounded unit.
A report that arrives and is conveyed carries earlier peoples into the present reading.
An example functioning as lesson converts history into a repeatable pattern.
The reminder explicitly names the example's reactivating function.
Dwelling in prior dwellings makes historical residue spatially immediate.
Emergence into clarity turns those remains into legible evidence.

structural_cues: 14:45 joins dwelling in former habitations, clarification, and struck examples.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered days, reports, examples, and dwellings; I infer that their recurrence lets the focus reader reconstruct one pattern. They could alternatively remain separate admonitory episodes.

changed_reading.before: Tadhakkur is private recall of a known claim.
changed_reading.after: Tadhakkur is reconstruction of a transhistorical pattern from signs, reports, examples, and inhabited traces.

context_deltas.mechanism: A call without coercive authority leaves response attributable to the self; the later warning arrives before a fixed expiry after which people ask to answer and follow. The focus purposes are therefore accountable opportunities, not automatic effects.

activation_trace.role: Danger-reporting that wakes caution anchors the available response window.
The denied power or authority removes coercion from the response mechanism.
A verbal call supplies the noncoercive initiating act.
Answering speech places uptake with the recipient.
The self as the very person locates resulting blame in the responder.
The repeated warning places awakened caution before the depicted arrival.
A fixed terminal time bounds the opportunity to respond.
Temporal nearness and impending completion sharpen that bound.
The requested late answer reveals the response that was possible earlier.
Following behind converts answer into sustained conduct.
Denied removal exposes the failed assumption that the present state would not shift.

structural_cues: 14:22 denies coercive authority, then assigns blame to those who answered the call.
14:44 depicts a request to answer and follow only after punishment arrives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, voluntary answer, self-blame, warning, deadline, and late regret; I infer that warning preserves a pre-expiry response window. The purpose lams may alternatively state design without commenting on each recipient's completion.

changed_reading.before: Warning, knowing, and remembering are guaranteed outputs of exposure.
changed_reading.after: They are intended, noncoercive possibilities for which recipients remain answerable before the response window closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible markers, reflective seeing, creation in truth, and apportioned provision converge on one source; knowing the one deity becomes integration of distributed evidence rather than reception of a bare assertion.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower anchors the focus's epistemic result.
Oneness without partner is the conclusion toward which the evidence converges.
An evident sign supplies a distinguishable unit of evidence.
Reflective seeing turns observation into considered judgment.
Origination supplies a world-scale effect requiring attribution.
Reality-matching stability constrains that attribution against falsehood.
Repeated origination connects the earlier inference to the provision sequence.
Apportioned giving makes sustained provision another attributable effect.

structural_cues: 14:19 explicitly prompts seeing and joins creation to truth.
14:32 repeats the same divine subject across creation, water, produce, transport, and rivers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies signs, reflective sight, origination, truth, and provision; I infer that convergent attribution supports the focus's knowledge of one deity. These items could instead function as exhortative examples without a formal evidential sequence.

changed_reading.before: People are simply told the proposition that the deity is one.
changed_reading.after: People are asked to recognize one source by integrating distributed historical, created, and sustaining signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Association, rival parity, and embodied idols are progressively denied; universal exposure before the One and the matching of every acquisition with recompense turn oneness into exclusive governance of relation and outcome.

activation_trace.role: The worshipped referent anchors the claim in deity rather than abstract arithmetic.
Oneness without partner supplies the focus's explicit exclusion.
Association with God supplies the partnership structure being rejected.
A rival counterpart supplies the false parity that diverts from the path.
A worshipped body materializes the rival relation.
Universal emergence into exposure removes protected rival spaces.
The repeated One without partner publicly resolves the earlier contest.
Dominance from above makes exclusive governance effective rather than nominal.
Matching deed with recompense displays governance at the level of outcome.
Acquired gain supplies the individual action to which that outcome is matched.

structural_cues: 14:22, 14:30, and 14:35 present association, rivals, and idols.
14:48-51 move from universal exposure before the One to recompense for every self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies competing relations and their final public collapse; I infer that focus oneness names exclusive governance across worship and consequence. A live alternative is that the judgment scene intensifies sovereignty without changing the semantic force of one.

changed_reading.before: One deity is primarily a numerical assertion.
changed_reading.after: One deity is the exclusive governing relation that invalidates rivals and alone closes every acquired act into its outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same public category receives book, example, and warning, yet many stray while some hearts incline; the focus's move from people to possessors of cores marks universal circulation with differentiated depth of uptake.

activation_trace.role: The human collective anchors the universal address.
Recovered presence supplies the deeper uptake assigned to the final subject.
The same human collective receives the opening book's outward movement.
Public humanity also receives the struck examples.
Reminder names the examples' hoped-for effect without asserting universal completion.
Departure from guidance supplies a contrary reception.
Numerical abundance makes that contrary reception socially substantial.
The straying group remains within the same public human audience.
The heart as an inwardly kindled center relocates reception beneath mere exposure.
The requested hearts are drawn from the wider human collective.
Inward inclination supplies a selective motion of reception.

structural_cues: The focus first names people generally, then gives recollection to ulu al-albab; l-b-b has no branch inventory and is used only as this structural narrowing.
14:36 and 14:37 place mass straying and heart-inclination within the same category of people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated public address, divergent straying, and inclined hearts; I infer differentiated uptake within universal circulation. The final subject could alternatively identify an exemplary class without partitioning the earlier purposes.

changed_reading.before: People form a homogeneous audience that realizes every stated purpose.
changed_reading.after: The message circulates to humanity at large, while warning, knowledge, and especially recollection actualize at different depths.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans cannot enumerate gift, are forbidden a false supposition of divine inattention, and finally meet a swift account; knowing and recollecting become correction of a defective calculus of gift, delay, and consequence.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure against ignorance anchors the corrected cognition.
Recovery from lapse keeps that correction active.
Counting supplies the attempted human calculus.
Good condition and gift supply what exceeds that calculus.
Exhaustive enumeration marks the failed limit of human accounting.
Supposition supplies the mistaken inference from delayed consequence.
Lapse outside vigilance names the falsely attributed inattention.
The opposite of delay corrects the earlier inference from postponement.
Actual accounting closes the sequence opened by failed counting and supposition.

structural_cues: 14:34, 14:42, and 14:51 form a sequence of failed enumeration, false supposition, and final account.
The focus assigns recollection to ulu al-albab; l-b-b is structural here because the packet supplies no branch inventory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three distinct calculating acts; I infer that their sequence diagnoses and repairs human judgment through the focus's knowing and recollecting. They may alternatively be independent rhetorical uses of neighboring accounting roots.

changed_reading.before: Knowing and remembering are general intellectual acts.
changed_reading.after: They recalibrate how people count gifts, interpret delayed judgment, and anticipate the final account.

Render it as an exploratory material analogy, not as a claim that balagh literally means tree.

changed_reading.after: Balagh can be carried as renewable cognitive provision, yielding recollection repeatedly from a stable verbal root.

Reaching a destination anchors the trajectory side of the contrast.
A useful item for needs and balagh creates explicit material contact with temporary equipment.
Extension until a limit gives temporary enjoyment a bounded reach.
Becoming toward an outcome identifies the destination that tests the equipment.

changed_reading.after: Balagh is counter-provision for a journey whose destination exposes the insufficiency of temporary enjoyment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the close in a legal-documentary register; it remains anchored in message-delivery and the focus branch of dhikr as a right-document, while the surah supplies binding writing, concluded judgment, recompense, and account. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: balagh at word 2 and tadhakkur at word 11

activation_trace.role: Formal delivery anchors promulgation in the focus noun.
A written instrument of right supplies the documentary image, with its distance from the reflexive surface contained.
Inscription that establishes a binding judgment gives the opening book juridical force.
A decisive judgment marks closure before the retrospective speech.
Matching action with recompense gives the notice an enforceable outcome.
Accounting supplies the record-closing function immediately before the focus.

changed_reading.before: The final verse is a devotional recap.
changed_reading.after: The final verse can also sound like public promulgation of a record whose warning, claim, and accountability have now been formally delivered.

strongest_changes: Balagh became an operative, locally intelligible extraction medium rather than inert information.
Tadhakkur became reconstruction of recurring history from signs, examples, and inhabited traces.
The purpose chain became a noncoercive response window bounded by expiry and accountable uptake.
Divine oneness became convergent attribution and anti-rival governance, completed in exposure and recompense.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet linked the opening book-light-language program to the closing balagh, then made historical recurrence, call and response, rival collapse, and the count-supposition-account sequence alter distinct parts of the focus without forcing one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The demonstrative's precise scope remains open between the whole discourse and the immediately preceding judgment sequence.
The purpose lams can state intended ends without settling how many recipients actualize them.
The ulu mapping and the botanical, counter-provision, and documentary readings remain deliberately branch-distant and exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The discourse is both delivered message and sufficient provision for response.** `ب ل غ` `B002` is conveying a message and `B003` sufficient provision; `ن ذ ر` `B001` awakens caution; `ع ل م` `B001` makes a thing clear. The entire surah repeatedly contrasts calls that arrive with promises that fail to arrive, and provision that sustains with provision inverted into torment. I infer this *balagh* reaches its audience with enough material to warn and make oneness knowable, while not coercing response. Delivery and sufficiency remain distinct coexisting readings.

2. **Recollection extracts the pure core from the full ayah walk.** `ذ ك ر` `B003` is bringing to mind and `B009` admonition; `ل ب ب` `B003` is the pure inner core and `B004` purified intellect. The rooted-word parable supplies the material analogy: fruit must be taken from a stable structure. I infer the “possessors of cores” can distill a governing relation from dispersed signs without discarding their particulars. The close reads as an instruction to perform integrative extraction.

3. **Oneness is the destination toward which warning and knowledge converge.** `و ح د` `B004` gives exclusive divine oneness; `ء ل ه` `B001` gives worship and the worshipped one. The three purpose clauses coordinate warning, knowing, and remembering. I infer these are distinct routes whose common role is to remove manufactured counterparts and re-center worship. The conclusion does not reduce cognition to fear or memory; it preserves all three operations.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah remained to activate a new relation. The retrospective surprise comes from the whole preceding sequence: message, provision, warning, oneness, and purified recollection converge without collapsing into one function.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The communication is a staged cognitive mechanism.** `ب ل غ B002` supplies conveying a message, `ن ذ ر B001` warning that awakens caution, `ع ل م B001` knowing as something becomes clear, and `ذ ك ر B003/B009` bringing to mind and admonition. The coordinated purpose clauses order conveyance → warning → knowledge → renewed remembrance. The packet supplies the stages; I infer that each enables the next. `هَذَا بَلَاغ` reads as a process designed to change cognition and action, not a notice of delivery alone.
2. **`بَلَاغ` is also sufficient provision for reaching the intended limit.** `ب ل غ B001` supplies reaching a limit and `ب ل غ B003` sufficient provision. The final demonstrative gathers the preceding warning scenes, fulfilled promise, transformation, and accounting into one delivered object. I infer that the message supplies enough material to reach its stated warning and knowledge aims. This does not claim exhaustive knowledge; it assigns functional sufficiency to the communication.
3. **Oneness is causal exclusivity disclosed by collapsed alternatives.** `ء ل ه B001` supplies worship and the worshipped one, and `و ح د B004` God's exclusive oneness. In 14:47-51, schemes do not evade, the world-frame changes, all appear to one subduing authority, offenders are bound, and every self is recompensed. The packet supplies the collapse of rival support; I infer that `إِلَهٌ وَاحِد` names sole effective worship-relation, not an isolated numeral.
4. **Remembrance belongs to the purified inner core.** `ل ب ب B003` supplies the pure core of a thing and `ل ب ب B004` purified intellect. The final window moved from transformed external world to visible bodies, garments, faces, and finally each self; the last clause relocates reception to an interior core. I infer that `أُولُوا ٱلْأَلْبَاب` are those whose cognition penetrates coverings to causal structure. Their remembrance is diagnostic understanding rather than recall alone.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ayah exists inside the clipped focus window. The retrospective therefore added no later surprise; the retained readings arise from the fixed sequence and the preceding five ayat only.

baseline.text: Bu, insanlar için bir bildiridir; onunla uyarılsınlar, O'nun tek bir ilah olduğunu bilsinler ve akıl sahipleri düşünüp hatırlasınlar diye.

findings.text: Bildiri, hedeflenen uyarı ve bilme sınırına ulaşmak için yeterli malzemeyi sağlayan bir azık işlevi de görür.
Tek ilah oluş, rakip desteklerin çöküşüyle açığa çıkan tek etkili kulluk ilişkisidir; yalnız sayısal bir birlik değildir.
Akıl sahiplerinin hatırlaması, görünür olayların içinden arı çekirdeği ve nedensel yapıyı ayıklayan bir kavrayıştır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temel olarak bir yere, şeye veya belirlenmiş son sınıra ulaşmayı anlatır. Bununla birlikte kullanım yalnızca gerçekleşmiş varışı kapsamaz; kimi bağlamlarda sınıra yaklaşmayı ve bir çocuğun olgunluk çağına erişmesini de içerir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım genel ulaşma çekirdeğiyle kalıp yer, süre, belirlenmiş sınır, yaklaşma ve olgunlaşma kalıplarını birbirine karıştırmadan ayırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ve özellikle bir iletiyi alıcısına ulaştırma veya ulaşmasını sağlama anlamını doğrudan destekler. Bu işlem, kişinin kendisinin bir yere varmasından ve söz söyleme niteliğinden ayrıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yaşamı sürdürmeye yetecek miktarı veya aracı ve kişinin elindekiyle yetinmesini birlikte destekler. Buradaki yeterlik, ileti ulaştırmaktan ayrı bir geçim ve yetme alanıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yaşamı sürdürmeye yetecek ölçü ve araçla sınırlıdır; bolluk veya kazanç edinme süreci değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yeterlik bildiren adlar ile eldeki geçim aracıyla yetinme kalıbı ayrıştırılır; kalıp yalın köke genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir konuda yeterli olma veya ihtiyacı karşılayacak ölçüde bulunma. Geçimlik, yiyecek ya da azık ve eldekiyle yetinme bu genel yeterlik çekirdeğinin özel kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir konuda veya gereksinim karşısında yeterli olma temel anlamdır.
Yiyecek, azık ve öteki geçim araçları somut yeterlik biçimleridir.
Kişi elindeki yeterli şeyle yetinir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yeterli ölçü, yaşamı sürdüren yiyecek veya geçim aracı ve bunlarla yetinme kullanımlarını aynı geçim çekirdeği altında toplar.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bedeni ayakta tutan yiyecek ile kişinin kendisini ve bakmakla yükümlü olduklarını beslemesini merkez alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, konuşanın amaçladığı anlamı açık ve etkili sözle karşı tarafa ulaştırabilmesini doğrudan tanımlar. Nitelik hem konuşana hem de bu niteliği taşıyan söze yüklenebilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sözlü anlatım yetkinliğiyle sınırlıdır; genel kalite veya iletinin fiziksel aktarımı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Konuşanın anlatım yetkinliği ile bu yetkinliği gösteren söz kalıbı ayrı yüzler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Konuşanın amaçladığı anlamı açık, düzgün ve etkili sözle karşı tarafa ulaştırma yetkinliği; aynı nitelik bunu gerçekleştiren söz için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Konuşan kişi, anlatmak istediği anlamı açık ve etkili biçimde karşı tarafa ulaştırır.
Bu anlatım yetkinliğini taşıyan kişi, dili güçlü ve amacını gerçekleştiren bir konuşmacı olarak nitelenir.
Söz de anlatılmak isteneni açık ve etkili biçimde ilettiğinde aynı nitelikle anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, konuşanın amacını söz aracılığıyla ulaştıran güçlü anlatımı hem bir kişi yetkinliği hem de söz niteliği olarak sunar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca yüksek kaliteyi değil, bir işte bütün gücü kullanıp eksik bırakmamayı ve pekiştirmenin son sınırına varmasını da kapsar. Bu nedenle dal, kalite başlığıyla sınırlanmayıp bir niteliği, işi veya pekiştirmeyi erişilebilecek en ileri dereceye götürme çevresinde yeniden kurulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yüksek kalite bu dalın yalnızca bir görünümüdür; çekirdek, ilgili ölçekte en ileri dereceye erişmedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yüksek nitelikli şey, çabada eksik bırakmama ve son derecedeki pekiştirme ayrı kalıplar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir niteliği, işi veya pekiştirmeyi ulaşılabilecek en ileri dereceye götürmek ya da o derecede olmak. Yüksek nitelik, bütün gücü kullanarak eksik bırakmama ve en güçlü pekiştirme bunun ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir ölçekte ulaşılabilecek en ileri dereceye erişme ortak anlam çekirdeğidir.
Bir şey nitelik bakımından çok iyi ve yetkin bir dereceye ulaşmış olabilir.
Bir işi yapan kişi bütün gücünü kullanır ve işi eksik bırakmaz.
Bir buyruk veya ant, tamamlanma ya da pekiştirme bakımından son dereceye ulaşır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı, yüksek nitelik, tüm gücü kullanarak eksik bırakmama ve tamamlanmış pekiştirme kullanımlarını bir derecenin sonuna erişme ortaklığında birleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çabayı eksik bırakmamayı ve bir pekiştirmeyi son dereceye götürmeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin iyi, düzgün veya işe yarar olmasını ve onu bu duruma getirmeyi genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir şeyin yüksek nitelikte olması iki dalın ortak bölgesidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı kaliteyi son dereceye erişme görünümüyle ve başka derece kullanımlarıyla birlikte kurar; komşu dalın çekirdeği doğrudan iyi ve düzgün olmadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bütün gücü kullanma ve pekiştirmeyi en ileri dereceye çıkarma değerlerini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin parçalarının tamamlanmasını, eksiğinin kalmamasını ve bütünlenmesini genel olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir ölçünün sonuna erişme ve eksik bırakmama düşüncesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı derece ve yoğunluk eksenindedir; komşu dal ise bir bütünün tamamlanması ve gereken parçaların yerine gelmesi eksenindedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İş çabası ve pekiştirme gibi kalite dışı alanlarda da en ileri dereceyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle güzellik, uzunluk veya irilikte benzerlerini aşan olağanüstü varlığı niteler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal, bir niteliğin olağan ölçüyü aşacak kadar ileri olmasını anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı farklı ölçeklere uygulanabilen son derece yapısıdır; komşu dal belirli görünür niteliklerde olağanüstü üstünlüğe bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; kalite, tamamlanma ve olağanüstü üstünlükle karışabilecek üç sınır seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, düşüncesizliği veya anlayış kıtlığı bulunmasına rağmen istediğini elde eden kişiyi anlatan sabit bir nitelemeyi açıkça destekler. Genel olarak hedefe ulaşmak ya da genel olarak düşüncesiz olmak bu özel birlikteliğin yerini tutmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İstenen sonuca ulaşma ile düşüncesizlik aynı kişide birlikte bulunmalıdır; dal bu kalıba özgüdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca düşüncesizliğine karşın istediğine ulaşan kişiyi belirten özel nitelemeyle sınırlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Düşüncesiz veya anlayışı kıt olduğu halde istediği sonuca ulaşabilen kişiyi niteleyen özel bir söz.

facets.statement: Kişide düşüncesizlik veya anlayış kıtlığı niteliği bulunur.
Aynı kişi bu niteliğine rağmen istediği sonucu elde eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, düşüncesizlik ile istenen sonucu elde etmenin beklenmedik biçimde aynı kişide birleştiği özel nitelemede uyuşur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca kişinin düşüncesizliği ile istediğini elde etmesi birlikte anlatıldığında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Düşüncesizlik niteliğini ve buna rağmen hedefe erişme sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin anlayış kıtlığına rağmen amaçladığı sonuca ulaştığını açıklayan bağlamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Olumsuz kişi niteliği ile başarılı sonucu aynı anda korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: düşüncesizliğine karşın istediğini elde eden kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sonuca ulaşan kişinin düşüncesiz veya anlayışı kıt olması zorunludur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kişinin aradığı ve amaçladığı şeyin son noktasına ulaşmasını herhangi bir kişi niteliği olmadan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişinin istediği bir sonuca erişmesi vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı başarıyı düşüncesizlikle karşıtlık içinde veren özel bir nitelemedir; komşu yalnızca aranan sonuca ulaşmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Düşüncesiz kişinin buna rağmen istediğini elde etmesi gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnızca kişiyi anlayışsız veya akılsız olarak niteler; herhangi bir sonuç elde etme içermez.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişiye düşüncesizlik veya anlayış kıtlığı yükler.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal kişi niteliğinde durur; odak dalı aynı niteliğe beklenmedik başarı sonucunu zorunlu olarak ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sonucu elde eden kişinin düşüncesizliği nitelemenin kurucu parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aranan nesneyi veya sonucu doğru biçimde bulup elde etme eylemini tek başına anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da amaçlanan veya aranan şeyin elde edilmesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı kişi hakkında karşıtlık içeren bir yargıdır; komşu dal sonucun bulunmasına odaklanan yalın bir eylemdir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; sonuca ulaşma, düşüncesizlik ve aradığını bulma bileşenlerini ayıran üç karşılaştırma yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, binicinin atın koşusunu artırmak amacıyla dizgini tutan elini ileri uzatması biçimindeki özgül hareketi doğrudan verir. Anlam atın hızlı olması değil, binicinin hızı artırmaya yönelik dizgin hareketidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca binici, dizgin hareketi ve koşuyu artırma amacı birlikte bulunduğunda geçerlidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım biniciye bağlı at ve dizgin kalıbıyla sınırlıdır; genel koşma, hızlanma veya bir yere varma anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Binicinin, atın koşusunu hızlandırmak için dizgini tutan elini ileri uzatması.

facets.statement: Eylemi yapan binicidir ve hareket dizgini tutan elle gerçekleştirilir.
Elin ve dizginin ileri verilmesindeki amaç atın koşusunu artırmaktır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, binicinin dizgini tutan elini ileri vererek atın koşusunu artırmaya çalıştığı özgül binicilik hareketinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: atı hızlandırmak için dizgini ileri verme
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca binicinin atın koşusunu artırma amacıyla yaptığı belirli dizgin hareketini temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Biniciyi, dizgin hareketini ve atı hızlandırma amacını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Binicinin atın koşusunu artırmak için elini ve dizgini ileri uzattığı sahnede kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Araç olan dizgini, binicinin hareketini ve hızlandırma amacını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: binicinin atı hızlandırmak için dizgini ileri vermesi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Koşuyu artırma isteği belirli bir el ve dizgin hareketiyle gerçekleştirilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Atı koşmaya yöneltme, dizgin hareketi olmadan da genel bir isteme eylemi olarak anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişi atın koşmasını veya daha hızlı koşmasını ister.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının ayırt edici yanı dizgini tutan eli ileri uzatmaktır; komşu dal atın koşusunu istemeyi daha genel biçimde verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Binicinin atı hızlandırmak amacıyla yaptığı dizgin hareketini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Atın, başka bir hayvanın veya binicinin gerçekleşmiş hızlı koşusunu ve yarışmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal atın koşusu ve hızının artması sahnesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı hızı doğurmaya yönelik binici hareketidir; komşu dal ise hayvanın veya binicinin hızlı koşma durumudur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dizgini ileri verme hareketinin amacı atın koşusunu artırmaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Binek hayvanının yürüyüşe yüklenmesini ve güçlü, hızlı koşma biçimini doğrudan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal binek hayvanının hareketi ve hızlanması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta binicinin araca yaptığı müdahale, komşuda ise hayvanın kendi yürüyüş veya koşu biçimi çekirdektir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dizgin hareketini koşuyu isteme ve gerçekleşmiş hızlı koşudan ayıran üç ilişki seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, yokluğun veya hastalığın bir kimse üzerinde ağırlaşmasını belirli bir kalıp içinde anlatır. Bu, genel güçlük adı veya hastalığın kendisi değil, olumsuz durumun kişiyi giderek daha şiddetli biçimde sıkıştırmasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yokluk ya da hastalığın belirli bir kişi üzerinde şiddetlenmesi kalıbıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca yokluk veya hastalığın bir kimse üzerinde ağırlaşmasını bildiren kalıba bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Yokluğun veya hastalığın bir kimse üzerinde ağırlaşıp onu iyice sıkıştırması.

facets.statement: Olumsuz durum, belirli bir kimseyi etkileyerek önceki düzeyinden daha ağır hale gelir.
Ağırlaşan durum yokluk ya da hastalık olarak belirlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yokluk veya hastalığın belirli bir kişinin üzerinde şiddetlenip ağırlaşması biçimindeki kalıplaşmış kullanımda birleşir.

concept_gloss.text: yokluk veya hastalığın kişiyi iyice sıkıştırması
concept_gloss.applicability: Olumsuz durumun yalnızca bulunmasını değil, belirli kişi üzerinde ağırlaşmasını anlatan kalıba uygulanır.

error_profile.preserves: Yokluk veya hastalığı, etkilenen kişiyi ve şiddetlenme sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yokluk ya da hastalığın belirli bir kişiyi giderek daha ağır biçimde etkilediği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiye yönelen etkiyi ve durumun şiddetlenmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yokluğun veya hastalığın kişinin üzerinde ağırlaşması

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yokluk veya hastalığın belirli bir kişi üzerinde giderek ağırlaşmasını anlatan kalıba bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sıkıntı, daralma, ağrı ve maddi ya da bedensel güçlüğü genel adlar olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da kişi ağır bir sıkıntı veya bedensel zorluk yaşar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı durumun kişi üzerinde şiddetlenme sürecidir; komşu dal sıkıntı ve güçlüğün kendisini daha geniş biçimde adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hastalığın kişi üzerinde daha da ağırlaşmasını anlatır ve yokluğu da kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sağlıklı ve dengeli durumdan çıkmayı, bedensel bozukluğu ve hastalık halini genel olarak tanımlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Hastalık, iki dalın kesiştiği durum alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında hastalık zaten vardır ve şiddetlenir; komşu dal hastalık durumunun kendisini ve sağlıktan sapmayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Şiddetin yokluk veya hastalık tarafından belirli kişiye yönelmesi gerekir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağır darbe, ateşli hastalık, zarar ve genel güçlük gibi çok çeşitli şiddetli durumları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da kişiyi zorlayan durumun şiddeti öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı iki belirli durumun ağırlaşma kalıbıdır; komşu dal farklı neden ve olaylardaki şiddeti geniş bir ad alanı olarak verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar incelendi; şiddetlenme sürecini genel sıkıntıdan, hastalıktan ve geniş zarar alanından ayıran üç ilişki yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, üzücü bir olayın benzerini yalnızca duymayı, fakat olayın konuşanların başına gelmemesini veya tamamlanmamasını dileyen kalıplaşmış sözü destekler. Bu anlam sıradan duyma ya da haber ulaştırma değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal üzücü olay karşısındaki korunma dileğiyle sınırlıdır; yalın işitme veya haber alma anlamına açılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kalıplaşmış korunma dileği dalın çekirdeğidir; üzücü haber adı ayrı bir sözlük birimi olarak tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Üzücü bir olayın benzerini yalnızca duymayı, onun konuşanların başına gelmemesini veya gerçekleşip tamamlanmamasını dileyen kalıplaşmış söz.

facets.statement: Konuşan, üzücü olayın benzerinden yalnızca uzaktan haber almayı kabul eder.
Aynı olayın kendilerine ulaşmaması veya gerçekleşip tamamlanmaması dilenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, üzücü olayın yalnızca duyulmasıyla bağlantılı kalıplaşmış korunma dileğini verir; bir yorum olayın konuşanların başına gelmemesini, diğer yorum ise işitilip tamamlanmamasını korur.

concept_gloss.text: üzücü olayı duyup ondan uzak kalmayı dileme
concept_gloss.applicability: Üzücü bir olay karşısında benzerinin konuşanlara erişmemesi veya gerçekleşmemesi dileğini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Duyma ile olaydan korunma dileğini aynı kalıpta birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzücü bir olay duyulduğunda aynı durumun konuşanların başına gelmemesi dilenirken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Uzaktan duyma ile olaydan korunma karşıtlığını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: insanı üzen ve kendisine ulaşan haber

neighbor_distinctions.gloss: üzücü olayı duyup ondan uzak kalma dileği
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da üzücü olayın duyulmasını, fakat konuşana erişmemesini dileyen aynı kalıplaşmış sözü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kaynak kartlarında kurucu koşul veya kapsam farkı görünmez; iki dal aynı korunma dileğini aynı sınırlarla verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Üzücü olayın yalnızca duyulması ve konuşanlara erişmemesi istenir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tökezleyen veya kötü bir olay yaşayan muhatap için doğrudan esenlik dileğinde bulunulur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kötü bir olay karşısında zarar görmeme dileğini sözle ifade eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı olayı uzakta tutmaya yönelik birinci çoğul korunma sözüdür; komşu dal olayla karşılaşmış muhataba yöneltilen esenlik dileğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Zararın gerçekleşmemesi sözlü bir dilek olarak ifade edilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir nesne, düşman veya yaptırım etkin bir araçla geri çevrilir ya da engellenir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da istenmeyen şeyin kişiye ulaşmaması amaçlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı bir korunma dileğidir ve etkin müdahale içermez; komşu dal zararı fiilen geri çevirme veya önleme eylemidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, çoğul biçimi bir kimseyi çekiştirip başkasına, özellikle etkili bir makama bildiren kötüleyici sözler anlamında tanımlar. Bu kullanım nötr ileti aktarımından ve sıradan haber vermeden ayrıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, başkasını kötüleyici bildirimlerle sınırlıdır; nötr rapor veya ileti aktarımı bu kapsama girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kanıtlanan yalın çoğul biçimin kötüleyici bildirim anlamıyla sınırlıdır ve kalıp dışı anlam eklemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimse hakkında başkasına taşınan kötüleyici bildirimler ve çekiştirmeler.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bildirim özellikle yöneticiye taşınır ve hedef alınan kişiyi ağır zarara uğratma sonucu öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişiyi kötüleyerek başkasına bildirme eylemini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısındaki insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ve tek bir üyesini birlikte gösterir. Görünür olma açıklaması adlandırma gerekçesidir; insan olmanın kurucu tanımı değildir. Evde kimsenin bulunmadığını bildiren kalıp ise dal çekirdeğine genellenemez ve yalnızca kendi sözcüksel biriminde korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insan türünü ve onun tekil ya da toplu üyelerini kapsar; yakınlık duygusunu, duyusal algıyı ve insana dönük yanı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimlerdeki insan ve insan topluluğu anlamı dal çekirdeğidir; evde hiç kimse bulunmadığını anlatan kalıp ayrı tutulur ve çekirdeğe yeni bir genel anlam katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında yer alan insan türünü, bu türün topluluğunu ya da tek bir üyesini belirtir. İnsanların görünür oluşu, bu adlandırma için aktarılan bir gerekçedir.

facets.statement: İnsan türünü, insanların oluşturduğu topluluğu veya bu türün tek bir üyesini görünmeyen varlıklar sınıfının karşısında adlandırır.
Adlandırmanın insanların duyularla görünür oluşuna bağlanması, anlamın özü değil kökene ilişkin bir açıklamadır.
